name: Discord
summary: Disable data personalization, restrict friend requests, and audit authorized third-party apps.

settings.name: Data Personalization
settings.impact: Discord collects activity data — which games you play, when you use the app, what content you interact with. Disabling all toggles limits what Discord can do with this data for ad targeting.
settings.source: Discord Data Privacy Controls documentation; Discord 2025 Policy Update

settings.name: Two-Factor Authentication
settings.impact: Discord accounts can be compromised via phishing and credential stuffing. 2FA with an authenticator app prevents account takeover even if your password is stolen.

settings.name: Friend Request Controls
settings.recommendedValue: Server Members or Friends of Friends
clickPath: Server Members or Friends of Friends
settings.impact: Allowing everyone to send friend requests opens you to unsolicited contact from harassers and spammers. Restricting to server members limits exposure to vetted individuals.

settings.name: Activity Status
clickPath: Display current activity as status message: Toggle OFF
settings.impact: Activity status broadcasts which games or apps you are using in real time to your entire server and friend list. Disabling prevents others from tracking your application usage.

settings.name: Authorized Applications
settings.impact: Third-party bots and apps authorized via Discord's OAuth can read your server memberships, messages, and profile data. Regular audits close data access from apps you no longer use.
settings.source: MyPrivacy.Blog Discord Guide 2025; Discord Safety documentation
